Hiring shouldn’t be painful. Good businesses deserve the right people—fast.

At Karyarth, this simple belief changed the way we approach recruitment. The name “Karyarth” means a vehicle (cart) for meaningful work, and that’s exactly what we aim to build—for both companies and candidates.

Seeing the real problem in Indian hiring, we noticed two major issues:
- Companies often struggle to find the right people, even after weeks of interviews.
- Most candidates (especially freshers) fail interviews—not due to lack of skill, but due to lack of preparation.

Our Two-Part Solution
1. Recruitment Services We're not merely a CV-sharing platform. Your growth is our goal, and we're creating the talent to make it happen. We focus on solving actual hiring problems:
- We start by understanding your business goals—not just your job descriptions.
- We aim to close roles in 5–7 days, respecting your timelines.
- We maintain full transparency throughout the hiring process.
- We measure success by your business results, not by the number of placements.
- So far, we’ve enabled 1500+ successful hires, with 95% of clients returning to work with us again.

2. Interview Bootcamps for Sales & HR Roles
Too many talented people are getting rejected. We’re working to fix that.
Our bootcamps focus on preparing candidates for real-world Sales and HR interviews—especially in industries like EdTech, FinTech, FMCG, and startups.
- Today, 8 out of 10 candidates fail interviews.
- Our mission is to shift this to a 60%+ success rate through proper training and guidance.

What Makes Karyarth Different
We’re not just filling job roles. We’re creating a stronger talent ecosystem.
- We help candidates grow into professionals.
- We help businesses hire better and faster.
From Lucknow to the world, we're not just recruiting.We're building the future of hiring.

title: Piramal - Portfolio Manager - Personal Loan Product

company.name: Piramal Pharma Limited
company.about:
Piramal Finance Limited (formerly known as Piramal Capital & Housing Finance Limited) at its core, believes we are a company that is of the people of Bharat and for the people of Bharat. Our story has been one of steady change. We entered the retail finance area with housing finance and now offer business loans and personal loans. We use customer feedback and new market opportunities to create long-term, value-driven financial services. At Piramal Finance, we put an emphasis on digitisation and online lending, while still giving our valued customers a human touch and expanding branches all over Bharat. We have come a long way already and want to keep going.

In retail lending, Piramal Finance Limited is one of the leading players that caters to the diverse financing needs of the under-served and unserved people of the 'Bharat' market. It offers multiple products, including home loans, loans against property, used car loans, and small business loans to budget-conscious customers at the periphery of metros and in Tier II and III cities. It serves millions of customers across India, with a presence in over 13,000 pin codes through a network of branches spanning 26 states.

In wholesale lending, the company focuses on both real estate and non-real estate sectors. Real estate developer financing offers tailored, asset-backed lending solutions across residential and commercial projects. The primary focus is on mid-segment residential developments, while also supporting affordable and premium housing projects across India's top 10 cities. In the non-real estate space, the Corporate and Mid-Market Lending (CMML) vertical provides customised funding to underserved small and mid-sized businesses with unique capital needs.
